page_title: CLE 1-5 MAR | Clermont v Marseille 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Clermont take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' 1 - 5 Goal! Ismaila Sarr plays a short, square pass into the path of Faris Moumbagna (Marseille), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 1:5. Fabulous goal!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Luis Henrique (Marseille) heads on.
83' Pascal Gastien prepares a substitution. Habib Keita is replaced by Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont).
83' It's time for a substitution. Joaquin Correa (Marseille) comes on in place of Amine Harit.
80' 1 - 4 GOAL! Luis Henrique (Marseille) runs onto a pass from Faris Moumbagna after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:4.
79' Clermont failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' An attempted cross from Neto Borges (Clermont) is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Clermont will have a corner.
76' The substitution has been made. Yohan Magnin (Clermont) has replaced Johan Gastien.
76' Substitution. Shamar Nicholson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Komnen Andric (Clermont).
75' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to make a change. Luis Henrique (Marseille) replaces Iliman Ndiaye.
75' It will be a substitution. Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) is ready to enter the pitch as Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang walks off.
72' 6:14 – the total goal attempt statistics.
68' The main referee, Thomas Leonard, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is given a yellow card for dissent.
67' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Ismaila Sarr laid the ball off to Jonathan Clauss (Marseille), who shot from close range into the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
66' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
62' A substitution has been made. Alan Virginius is replaced by Jim Allevinah (Clermont).
62' Substitution. Bilal Boutobba makes way for Elbasan Rashani (Clermont).
61' The referee signals a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Pape Gueye.
61' Jean-Louis Gasset decides to make a substitution. Azzedine Ounahi will be replaced by Jean Onana (Marseille).
59' 1 - 2 Goal 1:2! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
59' Mory Diaw makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) after a cross from the side.
58' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Clermont.
57' The corner from Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is cleared away by the defence.
56' Dangerous play by Quentin Merlin (Marseille). Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
53' 1 - 1 Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Clermont comes to nothing.
50' The ball is crossed into the box and Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Mory Diaw gets a glove on it to thwart him.
50' Pape Gueye (Marseille) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
48' A pass lands at the feet of Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45+1' Neto Borges (Clermont) receives a yellow card for infringement.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Marseille take a short corner kick.

45' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
45' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
44' A cross into the box from Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) is cleared. The ball is out of play and Marseille manage to earn a corner.
41' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Habib Keita (Clermont) sends a rebound goalwards towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.
39' Clermont have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Good work from Clermont as they win a corner.

38' A lofted cross from Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Clermont are awarded a corner kick.

37' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Mory Diaw was alert and the score remains the same.
36' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
34' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
34' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
33' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
30' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pau Lopez intercepts the ball.
27' Pape Gueye (Marseille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
23' A pass from Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) is intercepted by Mory Diaw and the move breaks down.
19' A sweet pass inside the box gives Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
18' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) commits a rough foul. Thomas Leonard stops the game and makes a call.
17' Johan Gastien finds Habib Keita (Clermont) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
15' Flag up against Shamar Nicholson (Clermont). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

14' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
13' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
13' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Marseille force their opponents to concede a corner.

11' Great solo effort by Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.

9' Johan Gastien (Clermont) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Pau Lopez and his nice save.
7' Habib Keita (Clermont) jumps into a tackle and Thomas Leonard signals a foul.
6' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
4' Amine Harit (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Amine Harit (Marseille).
1' The first half has just begun.
Marseille will kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will supervise the game today.
